# TeamForge

> TeamForge is an open-source real-time collaboration project for the Unity Editor. It explores live Scene synchronization, connected-user presence, same-Scene Hierarchy collaboration, locking and ownership, and P2P project bootstrap and transfer.

This file is the repository-level discovery index for AI tools, coding agents, and URL-retrieval systems. Prefer current-information sources over old implementation notes. For code questions, use the code map before scanning the entire repository.

## Fast routing by task

- **Current capabilities / release readiness:** [STATUS.md](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/STATUS.md)
- **Where code lives / which file to inspect:** [CODEMAP.md](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/CODEMAP.md)
- **As-built topology and authority boundaries:** [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)

- [Source guide](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/docs/SOURCE.md): Public source-tree and review entry points.

- [Security policy](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Security scope and reporting guidance.
- [Unity package metadata](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/unity-package/com.eunsung.teamforge/package.json): Package name, current version, and Unity compatibility metadata.

## AI-friendly website endpoints

These GitHub Pages endpoints are generated from canonical repository files during deployment so an AI tool does not need to depend on GitHub's rendered `blob` pages.

- [Project metadata](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/project.json): Current package version, source commit, project status, canonical repository, and machine-readable documentation/module URLs.
- [Code map](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/codemap.txt): Plain-text question-to-code navigation and module/file roles.
- [Architecture overview](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/architecture-overview.txt): Plain-text as-built architecture map.
- [Current status](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/status.txt): Plain-text current status.
- [Development history and changelog](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/changelog.txt): Plain-text version history and detailed package changelog.
- [Roadmap](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/roadmap.txt): Plain-text roadmap.
- [Source guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/source.txt): Plain-text source guide.
- [Architecture decisions](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/architecture.txt): Plain-text architecture decisions.
- [Unity module guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/unity-package.txt)
- [Server module guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/server.txt)
- [Project Peer module guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/project-peer.txt)
- [Launcher module guide](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/launcher.txt)
- [Full AI-readable context](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/llms-full.txt): Curated current documentation bundled into one plain-text file.

## Historical development records

- [Phase notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/phases/index.txt): Phase 0 through Phase 4 development records mirrored as plain text.
- [Work-state notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/work-state/index.txt): Historical implementation, debugging, hotfix, decision, and handoff notes mirrored as plain text.

Historical Phase and work-state notes may be rough, partially superseded, or describe experiments that later changed. Prefer `project.json`, `STATUS.md`, `CODEMAP.md`, module READMEs, current source/tests, and `CHANGELOG.md` for current facts.

## Interpretation rules for coding agents

1. Do not infer release readiness from the existence of source code; check `STATUS.md`.
2. Do not treat `ROADMAP.md` as implemented behavior.
3. Do not let `docs/work-state/` override current status, current source/tests, or the changelog.
4. Before changing authority, identity, transport, trust, persistence or activation behavior, read `docs/architecture.md` and relevant architecture decisions.
5. Prefer the smallest relevant module and its tests instead of loading every historical document.

## Important interpretation notes

- TeamForge is an early public preview, not a generally recommended production collaboration layer.
- Open source does not imply that a build is independently security-audited or safe from data loss.
- The project uses substantial AI assistance; implementation claims should be evaluated through source, tests, reports, and real-world validation rather than authorship assumptions.
